classification_rules.core: Stable for current v0 sampler in its allowed roles.
classification_rules.usable_watch: Context-limited; can be used in later/outdoor/background scenes but should be sampled at lower rate and visually gated.
classification_rules.exclude_v0: Kept in the library but excluded from current v0 automatic sampling.
classification_rules.allowed_roles: A texture may be good as a wall or natural ground but invalid as a tabletop/support.
